faq.q: What specific material properties make Titanium Subsea Wellhead Valve Block suitable for Subsea Christmas tree core block valve?
faq.a: Titanium Subsea Wellhead Valve Block uses Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V because its yield strength, fatigue endurance, and corrosion resistance directly address oil & gas operational demands. The alloy's specific strength enables mass reduction without section compromise, while the TiO2 passivation ensures long-term environmental resistance.

faq.q: What are the critical dimensional tolerances for Titanium Subsea Wellhead Valve Block?
faq.a: Standard machining tolerance for Titanium Subsea Wellhead Valve Block is +/-0.05mm (ISO 2768-m). Functional mating surfaces are held to +/-0.025mm with Ra 0.8um finish, verified specifically for subsea christmas tree requirements. Threaded features conform to ISO 965-2 Class 6g, verified with calibrated Go/No-Go ring gauges on 100% of production.

faq.q: Does Titanium Subsea Wellhead Valve Block require any post-machining surface treatment?
faq.a: Yes. subsea christmas tree components require Heavy-duty passivation 25% HNO3 45min per ASTM B600 for maximum chloride pitting resistance in seawater — tailored for subsea christmas tree application. This restores the natural TiO2 passive layer removed during machining and provides the required surface properties for the specific service environment. Key parameters include surface finish Ra 0.8um and passive layer thickness verification per applicable standards.
